cases.prompt: Open the console for the refund workspace
assertions: Runs doctor before prepare
Prints a 127.0.0.1 address and how to stop the server
Writes nothing outside console/

cases.prompt: Open the console when Node is not installed
assertions: Shows the install plan and asks once
Installs nothing before the user approves
Says everything except sw-view still works if the user declines

cases.prompt: Open the console when tasks.json is missing
assertions: Names sw-plan as the owner of tasks.json
Does not write the data file itself

cases.prompt: open the console after someone edited console/
assertions: prepare refuses and names the local changes
The user is asked whether to keep or replace them
Replacement uses --force only after a yes

cases.prompt: open the console while port 4173 is busy
assertions: The server takes the next free port
The address given to the user is the one the server printed

cases.prompt: Show me the PDF source behind FEAT-001 in the console
assertions: Starts the console with view.py serve, because file contents are only served there
Says that a copy-data static server shows the data but cannot read documents
Opens the item in the preview panel and never copies a file outside the project

cases.prompt: Show the graph of my two projects
assertions: Describes one graph per project, chosen with the project select, not one mixed map
Names the separate view for links that cross projects
States that the console only reads and never edits a spec

cases.prompt: Use sw-view to open a story that embeds an SVG diagram in its UI/UX section.
assertions: The preview panel shows the diagram inline from the document server (view.py serve)
Clicking the diagram opens the SVG file in the panel at full width
An HTML diagram is not offered for preview and the panel says only Markdown, PDF and images open

cases.prompt: Use sw-view to preview a story whose criteria are written as bold Given, When and Then bullets.
assertions: The preview shows the criteria as cards with a count, kind chips with counts, and a Cards and Table switch
A Given shared by three or more criteria appears once as a Background block naming them, not on each card
Quoted text in a step is set as a value chip, and the story file is not changed

cases.prompt: Use sw-view to preview a task from a plan's tasks file.
assertions: The preview shows a Tasks heading with a count, layer chips, and a Cards and Table switch
The task that was chosen is open and highlighted, and each card lists Done when, Traces to and the other labelled lines
A task without labelled lines keeps its text as written, and the plan file is not changed
